figures.finding: Kuwait has no rule of its own for child performers: employing anyone under fifteen is prohibited, and juveniles of fifteen to eighteen may be employed only with the Ministry's permission, outside hazardous trades and after a medical examination repeated at most every six months, for at most six hours a day with no more than four in a row before an hour's rest, and never overtime, on rest days or holidays, or from 19:00 to 06:00.

value.permit: إذن من الوزارة (Ministry permission) for ages 15-18
value.medical: before starting, then at most every 6 months
value.reachesWritingDirecting: general labour law: any employment in the private sector

ويحظر تشغيلهم ساعات عمل إضافية أو في أيام الراحة الأسبوعية وأيام العطل الرسمية أو من الساعة السابعة مساء حتى الساعة السادسة صباحا

figures.finding: A nominee for a Kuwaiti company's board must have the legal capacity to act (which follows the Civil Code's majority, not read).

value.rule: legal capacity to act (Companies Law art. 193(1))

sources.said: Any person nominated for membership in the board of directors shall meet the following requirements: 1. He shall have the legal capacity to act.
